spec_case: issue #627 (cache tokens on an if/while model-mode condition and an expect: {mode: model} check)
description: A model-mode if's condition, a model-mode while's condition, and a tool's expect: {mode: model} check each report cache reads/writes on their own adapter call -- the if and the while's own meta carry tokens_cached_in/tokens_cache_write (the while's own tokens_cached_in_total/tokens_cache_write_total too), the tool's meta.expect carries its pair, and the run's own totals sum all three.
